rules: Extraction is abstract-only: nothing is added from outside knowledge except rsID normalization (variant names like R577X/I-D mapped to rsID).
Null/absent fields are omitted. recommendation is present ONLY if the abstract itself supports it.
variant_rsid: unified dbSNP rsID. variant_label keeps the original name when the abstract used one (e.g. R577X, I/D). rsid=null when the abstract does not identify a specific variant.
schema_notes.direction: favorable | unfavorable | null | mixed  (effect of the listed allele on the stated category outcome; for Injury_Risk, favorable = protective)
schema_notes.evidence_level: meta_analysis | systematic_review | gwas | case_control | rct | cohort | narrative_review | case_report | mechanistic
schema_notes.category: Power | Endurance | Strength | Recovery | Injury_Risk | Nutrition | Metabolic | Behavior

40650118: allele model OR=0.85 (<1) and recessive OR=1.29 point in different directions in the abstract; allele-to-risk mapping is ambiguous.
37588243: abstract says rs1800497 in methods but 'rs1800496' in results (typo in source).
33925504: editorial with NO abstract content ('[...]') -> no extractable findings. The old Gemini file listed 4 findings for it, which cannot come from the abstract.
37372415: old file had only 5 findings; the abstract lists ~22 allele-level markers (all included here).
